text: Is anyone else getting kicked off the wifi on floor 3?

Hi, the wifi on the 3rd floor keeps dropping, I can't join my call. Any fix? (Mira, desk 6)
Let me check with the network team.
Please forget the network and reconnect to the 5GHz one named 'Hub-5G', the 2.4GHz one is congested on that floor. If it still drops, switch to the ethernet port under the desk.
ok noted
My card doesn't open the door after 10:00, the reader just blinks red.
Your plan has day-access only (08:00-20:00). Evening access needs the 24/7 add-on; reply here if you'd like it switched on and I'll forward the request to billing.
Thanks!
Did a package arrive for me today? Tracking says delivered at 09:30.
Checking the mailroom.
Yes, it's in the mailroom shelf under your name. Pick it up at reception with your card; we hold packages for 5 days.
Thanks!
The printer near the kitchen says 'paper jam' but there's no paper stuck. My job is queued since 11:45.
On it.
Cleared it: the rear tray sensor was stuck. Your job printed. Next time, open the rear door once and close it; that resets the sensor.

Coffee machine on floor 2 shows error E81 and won't brew.
That code means the drip tray is full. Pull the tray out, empty it, push it back until it clicks. If it repeats, use the machine on floor 1 and we'll call the technician.

I need a guest pass for a visitor on 16.12.2031, her name is Keiko Arai. How does it work?
Register the guest in the app under Guests > Add (name + date). Reception will print a day pass; the first 4 guest days per month are free on your plan.
How do I book a meeting room for tomorrow? Can't find the button in the app.
In the member app go to Spaces > Rooms, pick the date, then tap the room's time grid. Bookings up to 2 hours per day are included in your plan.
